How it works

Three steps between a phone call and a release.

Most bonds are written within the hour. How long release takes after that depends on the jail, but we stay on it until they walk out.

01

Call us

Tell us the person’s full name, their date of birth, and where they’re being held. We’ll confirm the charges and bond amount with the jail.

02

Sign and pay

We walk you through a short agreement and the premium, which Louisiana sets at 12% of the bond. You can sign at our office or electronically.

03

We post the bond

An agent delivers the bond to the jail and we keep you updated until release. Then we make sure you know every court date.

What it costs

Plain numbers, set by state law.

In Louisiana, a bail bond premium is 12% of the bond amount, with a $120 minimum. That is the fee for the bond and it isn’t refunded when the case ends. The court may add a small statutory fee on top. You never pay the full bond amount to us.

Bond set by the courtYour premium (12%)
$1,000$120
$5,000$600
$10,000$1,200
$25,000$3,000

Collateral is only required on larger bonds. Ask us about payment plans when you call.

Services

Bonds for every kind of charge.

From a bench warrant for a missed court date to a felony bond set in the six figures, we write it. If you’re unsure what you need, call and we’ll find out.

  • Misdemeanor bondsTheft, simple battery, disturbing the peace, and other minor charges.
  • Felony bondsLarger bonds, including those that need collateral. We’ll explain exactly what’s required.
  • DWI / DUI bondsFast release after a drunk-driving arrest, including first offenses and repeat charges.
  • Domestic violence bondsHandled discreetly, with help understanding any no-contact conditions.
  • Drug charge bondsPossession through distribution, in Caddo, Bossier, and surrounding parishes.
  • Warrant walk-throughsHave a warrant out? We can arrange the bond ahead of time so you’re booked and released the same day.

About J&L

A small office that picks up on the first ring.

We’re a local, family-run bail bond company in the heart of downtown Shreveport. No call center, no runaround. When you call, you talk to an agent who can start your bond right then, and the same person stays with you through release and every court date after.

We treat the people we bond out, and the families who call for them, with the respect anyone deserves on a hard day.
